title: Quality Assurance Engineering Manager
description:
The Company
2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 50 Canada Recipient & Fast 500 North America Recipient 🏆

SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.
Utilities face urgent demand to replace inefficient legacy systems while managing increasing operational complexity, and evolving customer expectations. With more than a decade of experience, and a track record of successful implementations spanning water, electric, and gas utilities, SpryPoint has built a reputation as a trusted and mission-critical partner to utilities across North America.
We deliver comprehensive solutions including SpryCIS, SpryEngage, SpryMobile, and SpryWallet that modernize the entire meter-to-cash process. What sets us apart? Our "updates, not upgrades" approach, user-centric design, and unwavering focus on customer success.
Backed by strategic investment from Norwest Venture Partners since 2023, and an exciting new investment partnership from Insight Partners announced in 2026, we're accelerating our growth while staying true to our core values: lead with kindness, vision with impact, radical honesty, bold disruption, keep it simple, and execute with excellence.
Join our award-winning team in transforming an essential industry that powers communities across the Americas.
We are standing up a dedicated QA automation function, and we're looking for a QA Engineering Manager to build and lead it from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to shape a quality practice from scratch: you'll choose the tooling, set the standards, hire the team, and define how AI fits into how we test.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading the team and doing the work yourself: setting direction, hiring, and coaching on one side, and writing automated tests, building framework components, and reviewing code on the other. You'll lead by example and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls and earn the trust of the engineers you lead.
In your first 90 days, you'll start with discovery: partnering with our Principal AI Engineer and AI team to understand existing AI tools and practices, and working with engineering teams to understand current QA practices and define how QA and engineering will collaborate going forward. In parallel, you'll confirm prerequisites (environments, CI/CD, critical user journeys), select your tooling and framework, and stand up a proof-of-concept suite on the highest-risk flows. By the end of year one, you'll have delivered a working, trusted automation suite on critical flows, a small high-performing team, a quality metrics dashboard in active use, and a clear plan for AI adoption.
What You Will Do

• Define and own the quality engineering strategy and roadmap across our products.

• Stay hands-on: personally write automated tests, build framework components, and review code alongside the team (roughly half your time).

• Select the test automation tooling and framework, and set the standards squads build on.

• Integrate automated testing into our CI/CD pipelines and partner with DevOps on stable, repeatable deployments.

• Define quality gates: what blocks a merge and what blocks a release, aligned with engineering leadership and risk.

• Drive a risk-based approach to testing so effort goes where it protects clients most.

• Push tests down the stack (API before UI), drive down the flaky-test rate, and enable squads so the practice doesn't depend on any one person.

• Hire, coach, and grow

Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

About the role

The Senior Manager, Channel Partnerships role will be vital in executing our partnerships go-to-market motion focused on co-selling and referral partners for our Betterment at Work business line. This role will own a partnership’s channel and be responsible for acquisition, contracting, onboarding, and enablement. The role will collaborate deeply with sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, legal and finance.

This role is based in NYC. Below, we've reflected the base salary range we would offer for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to experience and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

• New York City: $135,000 - $160,000

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of commission and an incentive bonus. 

A day in the life

• Source, negotiate, and sign new channel partners in priority verticals for Betterment at Work.

• Build joint go-to-market plans with each partner, team mapping, referral paths, rep incentives, and success metrics.

• Lead partner activation after signature by coordinating onboarding, training, launch materials, and internal handoffs.

• Work directly with partner leaders and frontline reps to drive introductions, co-selling activity, and qualified pipeline.

• Manage partner pipeline, forecasts, and activity in Salesforce, and report progress, risks, and results to leadership.

• Support strategic deals by aligning pricing, approvals, and cross-functional execution with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Legal, Finance, Product, and Compliance.

• Identify what is and is not working across the channel, and adjust messaging, enablement, and partner focus accordingly.

• Bring voice-of-partner and market feedback into the business to inform roadmap, positioning, and channel strategy.

What we’re looking for

• 3-7+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or strategic alliances, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, retirement, payroll/HCM, benefits, or adjacent financial services.

• Proven success building referral and co-selling partnerships that generate qualified pipeline and closed revenue.

• Strong commercial operator who can own the partnership lifecycle end to end, from prospecting and contracting through onboarding, enablement, and growth.

• Confident relationship builder with executive presence and the ability to work effectively across partner organizations and internal cross-functional teams.

• Data-driven and organized, with strong judgment, prioritization skills, and fluency in pipeline management, forecasting, and Salesforce discipline.

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. Backed by a brand known the world over for gaming, entertainment, and hospitality, we operate like a fast-moving startup with a passion for building products millions of people play.

Two things at once: a new method for making all our games, and new kinds of games to make with it.
What's the position?
We are looking for a Principal Engineer, Game Innovation to be the technical lead for this effort. You will design and stand up the AI-assisted game development pipeline, own the architecture that takes a game from concept to a certified title live on our RGS, and build games on it yourself. You will pair with the Senior Producer, Game Innovation, who owns the product and the roadmap, while you own the technology and the build.
This is a hands-on principal role, not a management track. You will write code, make the architectural calls, and set the engineering standard for how AI-built games get produced and shipped in a regulated environment. The first question, can AI build a game, is already answered by working prototypes. The harder question is whether we can build a real framework that produces games we would put in front of real players for real money. That is your problem to solve.

• Build games, not just infrastructure. Stay hands-on. Prototype mechanics, build game clients and servers, and prove the pipeline by shipping real titles through it.

• Choose the stack. Make the build, buy, and partner calls on engine, tooling, and infrastructure, and standardize the studio on choices that are strong for AI-assisted development and support the client and server model.

• Partner across the business. Work with platform engineering, compliance, and our RGS and third-party partners. Bring the studio's math, art, and production talent along, and keep the bar high on quality and speed.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers who join this effort, establish the code review culture, and document the patterns so the pipeline outlives any one person.

title: Customer Service to UX Research Career Changer
description:
About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Comprised of top-tier talent worldwide, we offer a powerful blend of exquisite design, robust development, and strategic acumen. More than a company, BRIGHTSCOUT is a tribe dedicated to disrupting the tech industry with bold ideas and collaborative genius.

As a Technical Product Manager at BRIGHTSCOUT , you'll decide what gets built and why, then make sure it actually ships. On accounts where the client has their own product team, you'll partner with them to translate their vision into a backlog our engineering and design teams can execute against. On accounts where they don't, you'll be that product team: setting direction, making the calls a client's own PM would make, and representing their business goals inside every planning conversation.

This is a hybrid role by design. Some weeks you're closer to a Product Manager, working the vision, roadmap, and stakeholder tradeoffs. Other weeks you're closer to a Product Owner, writing acceptance criteria and keeping a sprint on track. You'll move fluidly between the two, and know which one a given moment calls for.

• Act as the acting product lead for clients without an in-house PM, building a working command of their business, users, and market deep enough to make credible calls on their behalf.

• 5+ years of experience spanning product management and product ownership, ideally including agency, consultancy, or client-services work - comfortable owning both ends of the job, from setting direction with a client to writing a precise acceptance criterion.

Wir sind fravio, eine junge, schnell wachsende Social Media Agency mit flachen Hierarchien und großen Ambitionen aus Köln. Unser Team arbeitet mit Brands wie Wolt, Miles, XING und Vodafone sowie den relevantesten Creators Deutschlands zusammen.
Unser Fokus: Innovative Social-Konzepte, skalierbare Influencer-Kampagnen und Street Generated Content (SGC). Wir suchen einen kreativen Kopf, der Social nicht nur konsumiert, sondern versteht, warum Dinge funktionieren, und daraus Konzepte baut, die Kunden begeistern.
Aufgaben
Deine Rolle
Als Social Creative bist du die kreative Speerspitze von fravio. Du entwickelst Social-First-Konzepte für unsere Kunden, von der ersten Idee über die Herleitung bis zur Präsentation. Du sitzt nicht im Hinterzimmer und lieferst zu, sondern stellst deine Ideen selbst vor, im Team und direkt beim Kunden.
Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption: Du entwickelst kreative Social-Konzepte und Kampagnenideen für Plattformen wie TikTok und Instagram, die auffallen und gleichzeitig umsetzbar sind.
Herleitung & Storytelling: Du baust nachvollziehbare Herleitungen, die den Kunden abholen. Eine Idee ist bei dir nie nur ein TikTok-Link, sondern ein durchdachtes Konzept.
Pitch-Präsentation: Du stellst deine Ideen selbst vor, intern und im Kunden-Pitch, und transportierst sie so, dass man sie kaufen will.
Trend-Radar: Du hast ein feines Gespür dafür, was auf Social Media funktioniert, erkennst Trends früh und übersetzt sie in Ideen für unsere Kunden.
Machbarkeits-Check: Du denkst Kreation und Produktion zusammen und weißt, was mit Creators, Budgets und Timelines realistisch umsetzbar ist.
Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Projektmanager:innen, Creators und Produktionen zusammen, um deine Konzepte auf die Straße zu bringen.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung: 2-3 Jah

title: Principal, Technical GTM Enablement
description:
THE ROLE

ClickHouse is the fastest, most resource-efficient open-source database for real-time analytics, and ClickHouse Cloud is growing across every region and segment. Our Solution Architects (SAs) are the technical heart of that growth: They run the proofs of concept, defend the architecture, and win the room against the largest data platforms in the world.

You will be the single owner of global technical sales enablement and SA onboarding at ClickHouse. You are integral in deciding what a ClickHouse SA needs to know, say and do in order to be successful, and you wholly own the build out of the programs to get them there. You will measure everything, incorporate AI, and drive real results that time to revenue impact. You are the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, Sales leadership, SA leadership, and the field.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You lead through influence, the systems you build, and the credibility you earn.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

GLOBAL SA ONBOARDING

- Design and run the end-to-end onboarding program for new SAs across AMER, EMEA, and APJ. These include but are not limited to: Technical foundations, ClickHouse architecture and internals, demo and POC craft, discovery and objection handling, competitive positioning, and our sales process.

- Define and certify ramp. Set clear 30/60/90-day milestones, build the certification and shadow-to-lead progression, and publish time-to-productivity as a metric leadership can see and trust.

- Make onboarding regionally real. Adapt the global program to how each theater sells, and coordinate cohort schedules, mentors, and live sessions across time zones.

TECHNICAL SALES ENABLEMENT STRATEGY AND EVERBOARDING

- Own the global technical enablement plan and its calendar. This includes the quarterly priorities, the programs behind them, and the communication that keeps SA and Sales leadership aligned on what is shipping and why.

- Run product-launch readiness for the field. Partner with Product and PMM so SAs have talk tracks, demo environments, hands-on labs, and competitive positioning before General Availability.

- Build the competitive and architecture curriculum. Deep dives, battlecards, and objection-handling playbooks against the platforms we meet most (cloud data warehouses, search and observability stacks, and incumbent OLAP systems).

- Extend enablement to adjacent technical roles as needed: Account Executives on technical fundamentals, Support on the sales motion, and partners on positioning.

DIAGNOSE, THEN PRESCRIBE

- Start from signals, not requests. Use call recordings, CRM data, win/loss, POC outcomes, certification results, and conversations with SA leaders to find the skill gaps that actually cost us deals, then classify and prioritize them with data.

- Pick the right modality for the gap: hands-on lab, self-serve path, live workshop, AI role-play, peer teaching, or in-the-moment coaching. Measure behavior change and deal outcomes.

- Close the loop. Systematically capture what is breaking in the field (friction, lost deals, recurring objections) and route it to Product, PMM, and Sales leadership as actionable recommendations.

BUILD AT SCALE

- Own the enablement toolchain: the LMS or learning hub, content repositories, certification tracking, and reporting. Keep a single source of truth for what is current.

- Activate SME communities. Identify and support the SAs who are already the best at something, and give them the structure to teach it peer-to-peer across regions.

STAY IN THE FIELD

- Spend roughly 10% of your time in customer-facing moments by joining POCs, account reviews, and live coaching.

- Facilitate. You will personally deliver live sessions, virtually and in person, at onboarding cohorts, regional kickoffs, and Kickoff events.

OPERATE LIKE AN OWNER

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Founded in 2013, Ignition is the leading revenue and billing automation platform for firms and agencies. We automate proposals, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering businesses to sell, bill and get paid faster.

Ignition automates proposals, engagement letters, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering 8,500+ businesses to sell, bill and get paid for their services with ease.

To date, Ignition customers have managed relationships with over 2.4 million clients and earned $13b in revenue via the platform. Ignition's global workforce spans Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, US and the UK.

COMPANY VALUES:

- We are better everyday

- We work without ego

- We are smarter together

- We hero our customer

ROLE LOCATION:

We are currently seeking a US based Mid-Market Account Executive. You will work primarily from your home office, with travel within the USA & Canada (50% as required and based on seasonality). The geographic areas of focus overall are Texas, California, Chicago, and the East Coast.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Ignition Sales team is highly collaborative and supportive. We work without ego, welcoming coaching and feedback in the pursuit of getting better everyday. We share calls and stories of our experiences with prospects, especially when things don't go as planned, because we want to help more prospects understand the value of what we offer.

 

We operate in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, where prioritization and organization are key to success. We are aligned on the process and activities that lead to winning results, while having a passion for our customer and how we can help them. Sales is the first human touchpoint in our prospect’s journey with Ignition. It is important we deliver a personalized and valuable experience with Ignition, ultimately converting our prospects to customers and growing revenue for the company.

This is a pivotal role at the forefront of Ignition’s growth strategy in the US and Canada. As an Account Executive focused on Mid-Market and Enterprise CPA firms, you will be assigned a book of business and will be responsible for creating, advancing, and closing revenue opportunities within that portfolio.

 

Success in this role comes from building and deepening relationships across multiple stakeholders within each firm, helping them understand the value of Ignition and the measurable impact our solution can have on their business. You will lead thoughtful, consultative sales conversations that connect firm priorities to Ignition’s ability to streamline and optimize revenue management from proposal to payment.

 

Ignition is the category leader in revenue management from proposal to payment, and we are prioritizing expansion in the Mid-Market and Enterprise CPA firm segment across the US and Canada. In this role, you will partner with firm leaders, operators, and decision-makers to uncover business needs, tailor your approach to each account, and guide opportunities through a more strategic, multi-threaded buying journey.

 

Join our team to play a critical role in expanding Ignition's presence in a key strategic market, while helping firms modernize the way they engage clients, bill for services, and collect payments.

 

DAY TO DAY

- Own and grow a defined book of business across Mid-Market and Enterprise CPA firms in the US and Canada.

- Build trusted relationships across multiple stakeholders within each account, including partners, firm owners, operational leaders, and other key decision-makers.

- Lead consultative discovery conversations to understand firm goals, current workflows, pain points, and opportunities for impact.

- Deliver tailored demos that align Ignition’s solution to each firm’s priorities and business outcomes.

title: Software Engineer Intern - Berlin (2027)
description:

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We cultivate an inclusive, welcoming, and empowering environment where every intern is set up for success from day one:

- Dedicated Mentorship & Support: High level of access to your manager and a personal mentor who provide guidance, constructive feedback, and continuous support without micromanagement.

- How to build enterprise-grade, reliable, and secure cloud software and services.

- Programming experience in C++ or Java, and familiarity with systems programming concepts (e.g., multi-threading, concurrency).

- Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and solve problems creatively.

- Fluent written and spoken English skills.

BONUS SKILLS (NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED):

- Coursework or familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, cloud computing, or compilers.

- Experience or interest in big data engineering, data processing, or geospatial features.

- Contributions to open-source projects, research experience, or publications in databases/distributed systems.

title: Junior Attorney (Probate)
description:
Company Overview:

Milestone is an innovator in post-settlement solutions, providing technology-enabled administration services to law firms managing complex mass tort settlements. Through its proprietary Pathway® platform, Milestone has transformed post-settlement distribution by delivering a more efficient, transparent, and data-driven process for managing claims administration and settlement disbursement.

Position Description:

Support the day-to-day operations of Milestone 's Probate Department by partnering with the Managing Attorney to ensure the efficient administration of probate matters, coordinate with external legal partners, and promote operational excellence across the department. Serve as a key legal resource by overseeing local counsel relationships, supporting team coordination, monitoring case progress, and helping drive the successful execution of departmental priorities.

• Partner with the Managing Attorney to support the day-to-day operations and overall effectiveness of the Probate Department.

• Provide operational oversight and guidance to probate team members, supporting efficient workflows, collaboration, and timely case progression.

• Coordinate team workloads and case assignments to help ensure deadlines, quality standards, and departmental objectives are achieved.

• Review probate matters for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable laws, court requirements, settlement agreements, and internal policies.

• Collaborate with the Managing Attorney on probate strategies, legal issue resolution, and departmental initiatives.

• Review project and case status reports to identify workflow bottlenecks, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous process improvement.

• Prepare operational reports, case updates, and departmental metrics for leadership.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to support probate-related initiatives and ensure seamless case administration.

• Assist with the development, implementation, and refinement of departmental procedures, workflows, and training materials.

• Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound legal judgment when handling sensitive claimant and estate information.

• Respond promptly to internal and external communications while effectively managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Perform additional legal and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements & Qualifications:

• Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.

• Active license to practice law and member of a state bar in good standing.

• Two (2) to four (4) years of experience practicing probate law.

• Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring legal professionals or support staff.

• Strong knowledge of probate procedures, estate administration, and court processes across multiple jurisdictions preferred.

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and team workloads in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Experience in Mass Tort Law preferred.

title: M&A-Manager (m/w/d)
description:
deine aufgaben
Für den Ausbau unserer M&A-Aktivitäten suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit 4-8 Jahren Erfahrung in M&A oder Corporate Development. Du identifizierst passende Unternehmen, baust nachhaltige Sourcing-Pipelines auf und begleitest Transaktionen vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Closing. Besonders wichtig ist uns Erfahrung im Umgang mit gründergeführten Small Caps.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du baust eine strukturierte Longlist potenzieller Zielunternehmen auf und entwickelst eine verlässliche Sourcing-Kadenz - mit einer Zielgröße von rund 250 Ansprachen pro Jahr.

• Du recherchierst und priorisierst Unternehmen anhand strategischer und finanzieller Kriterien.

• Du verantwortest die Erstansprache und führst einen wertschätzenden, vertrauensvollen Dialog mit Gründerinnen und Gründern.

• Du steuerst Transaktionsprozesse end-to-end - von der Kontaktaufnahme über NDA und LOI bis zum Closing.

• Du koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte und einen verlässlichen Prozessfortschritt.

• Du erstellst prägnante 2-Pager, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Unterlagen für Beiratssitzungen.

• Du hältst Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Prozessstatus transparent nach und leitest daraus Prioritäten für das weitere Sourcing ab.

dein profil

• 4-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in M&A, Corporate Development, Transaction Advisory oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion.

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Anbahnung und Durchführung von Transaktionen.

• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit gründergeführten Small Caps und ein gutes Gespür für die Perspektive von Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern.

• Sicherheit in der Recherche und Bewertung potenzieller Zielunternehmen sowie in der strukturierten Pflege einer M&A-Pipeline.

• Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten - besonders in der Erstansprache und im persönlichen Gründerdialog.

• Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen schnell zu erfassen und in prägnanten 2-Pagern und Entscheidungsvorlagen aufzubereiten.

• Eine eigenständige, verbindliche und diskrete Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Organisation und Durchhaltevermögen.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Was dich in der Rolle erwartet
Du verbindest systematisches Sourcing mit persönlicher Beziehungspflege und konsequenter Prozessführung. Dabei erhältst du die Möglichkeit, den M&A-Funnel aktiv mitzugestalten und Transaktionen in einem unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld voranzubringen.

Wenn du M&A-Prozesse eigenständig vorantreibst, gern mit Gründerinnen und Gründern arbeitest und Erfahrung mit Small Caps mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte sende deinen Lebenslauf und - sofern verfügbar - eine kurze Übersicht relevanter Transaktionserfahrung.
wir bieten
Neben unserem hoch motivierten Team und einem erfolgreichen Produkt:

✓ Innovation mit Sicherheit: Bei uns trifft Start-up-Atmosphäre auf wirtschaftliche Stabilität.
✓ Work-Life-Balance: Wir fördern einen Arbeitsalltag frei von Überstunden, Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit.
✓ Diversität und Transparenz: Sei wie du bist. Ein offenes Arbeitsumfeld und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe erwarten dich.
✓ Fort- und Weiterbildung: Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an deinem Karriereweg bei uns.
✓ Weitere Benefits für dein Wohlbefinden: (virtuelle) Teamevents, Rabatte für Mitarbeitende, Sportangebote, Mentoring & Coaching, Gesundheits- sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge u. v. m.

description:

• Develop action plans, handle client escalations, and maintain internal trackers with issue escalations as needed.

• Build, oversee, and analyze a range of operational and client-facing reports to provide actionable insights and ensure alignment with client expectations and organizational goals.

• Manage administrative responsibilities such as approving direct associates' expenses and timecards (including revisions), maintaining an in-depth understanding of client systems and payer portals, and ensuring accurate documentation is available and utilized effectively.

Bachelor's - Equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of a degree

Minimum of 2 years of experience

title: Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager (copy)
description:
The Encounter Data Submissions Program Manager will assist in the development of an end to end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, to include creation of program guide and standard operating procedures. The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes.
This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data-the lifeblood of value-based care-is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity.
 
We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.

Who We Are:
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.
 
What Does This Mean for You?
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
 
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
 
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!

title: Strategic Finance Associate/Sr. Associate - Product
description:

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a Strategic Finance Associate / Sr. Associate to join our growing Strategic Finance team, with a focus on Product finance. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders to shape the financial strategy of our business. You will build and maintain financial models, develop KPI frameworks, and deliver insights that influence product investments and growth priorities.

You'll also be a core finance partner on Zip's AI strategy, from how we price and package to how we forecast AI revenue and the inference costs that come with it.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll play a critical part in connecting product strategy with financial outcomes, supporting long-range planning, and influencing decisions at the executive and board level.

- Design and manage the financial models that support our annual plan, long-range forecast, and multi-product growth strategy

- Partner with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders to set topline targets, evaluate roadmap investments, and align on strategic priorities across the business

- Model the financial impact of Zip's AI products and decisions, including pricing scenarios, unit economics, gross margin, and investment cases for new capabilities

- Create and maintain KPI frameworks that track product performance and sales efficiency, giving leadership a holistic view of the business to guide resource allocation

- Support executive decision-making by preparing high-quality board materials, investor updates, and leadership presentations

- Drive company-wide forecasting and reporting processes across revenue, expenses, headcount, cash flow, and retention metrics

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 2+ years of private equity, investment banking, or similar experience

- Experience in strategic finance at a high-growth technology company is a plus

- Familiarity with technology, SaaS, and usage-based business models

- Excellent financial modeling and quantitative skills

- Extreme attention to detail with a high regard for precision

- Strong written and verbal communication

- Ownership mindset with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams and stakeholders

The salary range for this role is $128,000-$184,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

title: Contact Center Systems Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Contact Center Systems Engineer to support a large-scale, global enterprise contact center environment.
This role combines production support and platform engineering , including contact center routing, telephony troubleshooting, Linux-based systems, integrations, and migration from an existing commercial platform to a next-generation platform built on open-source telephony technologies.
Key Responsibilities

• Configure and maintain routing strategies, queues, IVR flows, and agent targeting across voice, chat, email, and task channels

• Troubleshoot production issues across telephony, network, and application layers

• Diagnose voice quality issues including latency, jitter, packet loss, codecs, and media-path problems

• Troubleshoot SIP/VoIP call flows and routing logic

• Support number provisioning, porting, and regional routing

• Analyze existing contact center configurations and map them to a new platform architecture

• Build and validate configurations in Linux environments

• Support platform migration and feature-parity testing

• Integrate systems using REST APIs and webhooks

• Participate in production incident triage and resolution

• Create technical documentation, runbooks, and structured shift handovers

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise Contact Center platforms

• Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Avaya, Cisco , or similar platforms

• Strong knowledge of SIP, RTP, and VoIP

• Experience troubleshooting call flows, routing logic, and media-path issues

• Networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and QoS

• Strong Linux skills including service configuration, log analysis, and command-line troubleshooting

• Scripting/programming experience with Python, JavaScript, or Bash

• Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, Git, and deployment workflows

• Experience supporting and troubleshooting production systems

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, OpenSIPS, Asterisk , or similar open-source telephony technologies

• Contact center platform migration experience

• Experience with Wireshark, sngrep, sipgrep, or HOMER

• Terraform or Ansible

• Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog

• SQL fundamentals

• Cyara or other automated voice-testing platforms

• Exposure to AI-enabled contact center capabilities such as virtual agents, intent-based routing, or speech analytics

• ITIL / ITSM familiarity

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Join Our Pipeline for Future Opportunities!

This posting is intended to establish a pool of qualified candidates for future openings supporting ongoing operations. Positions may become available based on staffing needs, operational requirements, or workforce changes. Qualified applicants may be contacted as opportunities arise.

Job Summary

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking an RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist to support the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Walla Walla Business Intelligence (WWBI) program. This role owns cybersecurity compliance, Risk Management Framework (RMF) documentation, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and authorization artifacts, working closely with software developers, DevSecOps personnel, technical leadership, and Government stakeholders to ensure WWBI continuously complies with applicable Department of Defense (DoD), U.S. Army, USACE, and Civil Works Business Intelligence (CWBI) cybersecurity requirements. This position also supports maintenance of the WWBI authorization package and the program's planned migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual integration into the CWBI security boundary.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, update, and maintain WWBI Risk Management Framework authorization documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP), Incident Response Plan (IRP), System Design Documents, and related authorization artifacts.

• Manage and document program-specific security controls applicable to the WWBI system, and support security requirements associated with Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

• Maintain documentation defining the WWBI authorization boundary, including applicable hardware, software, ports, protocols, interfaces, and data flows.

• Coordinate cybersecurity documentation and compliance activities associated with WWBI's migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual incorporation into the CWBI authorization boundary.

• Maintain WWBI compliance records within the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS), including uploading, mapping, organizing, and maintaining required RMF documentation, security-control evidence, implementation statements, and supporting artifacts.

• Support execution of the WWBI continuous-monitoring program, including coordinating and/or performing required ACAS and SCAP security scans, and maintaining a compliance score of at least 90% for applicable SCAP scans.

• Import and maintain security-scan results within DISA STIG Viewer and eMASS; analyze identified vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation activities with software developers and Government technical personnel.

• Track Critical and High findings for immediate remediation, Moderate findings for remediation within 60 days, and Low findings for remediation within 120 days; document approved exceptions and outstanding findings within the Plan of Actions and Milestones (POA&M).

• Develop, maintain, and submit the quarterly POA&M report detailing open, remediated, and outstanding security findings, and support quarterly updates to the RMF documentation package.

• Provide ACAS/SCAP scan results and associated STIG Viewer files following required scans, and maintain current system security, network topology, logical, and data-flow documentation in coordination

title: Deployment Strategist - Chile
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

 

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

- Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

- Own flagship deals end-to-end - from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

- Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

title: Senior Product Manager - Machine Learning (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION: TURNING MACHINE LEARNING CAPABILITIES INTO REAL USER VALUE

voize is more than a scribe and far more than another documentation tool! We're defining & setting the benchmark what AI in healthcare actually looks like. As Product Manager - ML, you’ll sit at the core of our product, you’ll translate customer, Sales, and Customer Success signal into the ML product roadmap across our markets - defining what “better” means for our models, aligning stakeholders on priorities, and driving a shipping cadence that turns ML capability into measurable user value.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Own the ML product roadmap for core speech and NLP across our markets, turning field signal into clear priorities

- Run a structured customer-feedback → ML loop with Sales, Customer Support and Customer Success, and direct customer conversations (and close the loop back to the field)

- Define and maintain the model evaluation framework that gates releases (metrics, slices, thresholds, regression bar)

- Partner closely with Speech & NLP Leads as your roadmap counterparts to ship improvements to production

- Improve the product analytics and ML data integration: close the gaps between what we want to achieve, what we can measure in production, and what we train our models on.

- Own ML product KPIs (e.g., no-edit rate, documentation rate, edit rate per slot, transcription accuracy) and drive measurable improvements.

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- Extensive Experience in Product Management, background in speech recognition, NLP, or LLM-based product is a plus.

- Strong technical fluency in ML: evaluation, training data, latency/quality trade-offs, and release mechanics (you don’t need to train models, but you do need to deeply understand them)

- Track record of shipping ML-powered products to production with measurable user impact

- Hands-on experience designing and operationalizing ML model evaluation frameworks

- Excellent communication in English; German is required to lead customer and end-user conversations (roughly B2)

- We are open to relocators, but this role is ideally based in Berlin and you’ll work in a hybrid set-up.

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

- Become a co-creator of our success with a competitive s stock option program

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

- You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up, plus dedicated remote working days within the EU.

✨ READY TO TALK? APPLY NOW! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

title: Senior Federal Pricing Manager
description:
The Challenge:

JCTM is increasing the size, complexity, and strategic importance of the federal services opportunities it pursues across prime, subcontract, joint venture, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order environments. As our federal portfolio grows, JCTM is strengthening its pricing capability to bring competitive pricing analysis earlier into capture, improve proposal economics, protect execution feasibility, and give leadership better information for pursuit and investment decisions.

The successful candidate will be able to analyze available customer, competitor, labor-market, contract, and cost information and clearly explain: “Here is the likely competitive range, here is where our current price sits, here are the major drivers, here are the available levers, and here is the pricing approach I recommend.”

JCTM is looking for an experienced, hands-on federal pricing professional who understands that successful pricing goes beyond completing a cost model. This person will help JCTM understand what a competitive price may look like, how the proposed solution and staffing model affect that price, and what adjustments may improve both competitiveness and execution.

Build Your Career:

This role is an opportunity for an experienced Senior Pricing Analyst, Pricing Manager, Senior Pricing Manager, or similarly qualified federal pricing professional to take on greater ownership, work directly with senior leadership, and help mature JCTM ’s strategic pricing capability. You will remain close to the work, building and reviewing pricing models, analyzing competitive ranges, evaluating staffing and labor assumptions, supporting BOEs, and pricing major federal pursuits, while gaining increased responsibility for pricing strategy and executive-level recommendations.

Challenging Projects:

As the Senior Federal Pricing Manager, you will lead hands-on pricing activities for significant federal pursuits and help mature JCTM ’s competitive pricing and Price-to-Win capabilities. You will develop and evaluate pricing scenarios, conduct competitive pricing analysis, assess staffing and solution economics, review BOEs, and translate incomplete market and acquisition information into defensible recommendations.

Working with Growth, Capture, Finance, Operations, Proposal, Recruiting, HR, and technical SMEs, you will help leadership understand where JCTM ’s proposed pricing sits relative to the competitive environment and identify practical levers that can improve competitiveness without undermining successful execution. This position offers significant visibility to JCTM leadership while providing room to grow into broader ownership of the company’s pricing strategy, processes, tools, and competitive-pricing infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

Federal Proposal Pricing & Financial Modeling

• Independently develop, maintain, audit, and troubleshoot complex federal proposal pricing and financial models.

• Develop pricing for labor-intensive federal professional services opportunities, including complex multi-year pursuits and task orders.

• Support FFP, FFP-LOE, T&M/Labor Hour, CPFF/cost-reimbursable, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order pricing environments.

• Model and analyze direct labor, fully burdened rates, fringe, overhead, G&A, escalation, subcontractors, consultants, travel, ODCs, fee/profit, gross margin, and total contract value.

• Perform mathematical, formula, compliance, reasonableness, and sensitivity checks before executive review and proposal submission.

• Develop multiple executable pricing scenarios and clearly explain the financial, competitive, staffing, and margin implications of each.

Competitive Pricing & Price-to-Win Analysis

title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience
description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform-where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

Role Summary:
Every engineer pays a tax on slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, and tooling they have to work around. That tax compounds, and it’s paid by every team, every day, and it never shows up on a roadmap. This role exists to pay it down, so that everyone building software for legal teams can ship faster.
Today the largest known cost is the path from commit to production: GitLab CI for build, Octopus Deploy for release, across .NET, Python, and Svelte. That’s where you’ll start, and it isn’t where the job ends. The same mandate covers developer platform work, internal tooling, and purpose-built solutions for one team’s specific problem. What stays fixed is the measure: how much faster we ship, and how much friction you took out. You’ll have a strong hand in choosing the means. This is a senior individual contributor role, and your leverage comes from what you build and who you persuade.

Compensation Information: $190k - $230k

This position is also eligible for a paid time off policy, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Product Manager (LATAM)
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager for to join a globally distributed product and engineering team. The job is to turn business priorities into work engineers can pick up and ship, then stay with it through release.
This is hands on and execution first. You break the features them into requirements, sequenced plans and tickets that hold up under pressure. Day to day you're working with engineers, QA and business stakeholders, keeping projects moving and expectations honest.
There's room to grow. The product practice is still being built out, so discovery, PRDs, retrospectives and data informed prioritization are all things you'll be exposed to and can grow into over time.
Your first 6 months

• You own a portfolio of live projects end to end, from requirements through release, and everyone always knows where each one stands.

• Messy, multi part initiatives arrive from marketing, ops and customer experience, and you turn them into plans people can execute against.

• Your specs and acceptance criteria cut rework, with QA looped in early instead of at the end.

• You know the e-commerce stack, subscription flows and customer journeys well enough that engineers and stakeholders come to you first.

• You're contributing to sprint process, retros and planning cadence as the practice matures.

Who we're looking for

• 2-4 years in product management or technical project management. E-commerce or consumer products is a plus.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You write clear tickets, requirements and status updates, and you keep a distributed team aligned without endless back and forth.

• You chase ambiguity down rather than waiting on it, and you flag risk before it turns into a delay.

• Comfortable in Jira and Figma, at home with analytics tools. Shopify or other subscription commerce platforms a plus.

• Someone the team wants to work with. Much of this job is sitting between engineers and stakeholders, so being easy to collaborate with matters as much as process skill.

• Keen to grow as a PM, with mentorship and increasing ownership over time.

Engagement
Full time, remote, long term contract. Candidates based in South America with substantial overlap with US business hours.
